name: Milan Linate Airport

runway.v: main runway 18/36, 2,442 m long and 60 m wide (a second runway, 17/35, is 601 m x 22 m)

slots.v: a coordinated airport (slot allocation by Assoclearance)
slots.quote: ha classificato come aeroporti coordinati gli scali di: ... Milano Linate

handling.v: general aviation is handled at the A.T.A. traffic office; listed: ATA Linate West (06:00-22:00, summer 05:00-21:00), Sky Services (05:00-21:00, summer 04:00-20:00) and Universal Aviation Italy (06:00-22:00, summer 05:00-21:00)
handling.quote: All operations referring to General Aviation traffic will be carried out at the A.T.A. traffic office.

notes: ENAV eAIP (AIP Italia) needs an ENAV account and could not be opened, so customs, night rules and GA rules from AD 2 are missing. All facts except slots come from SEA's 'Technical data' page (no date; © 2026). The page does not say whether the handler hours and the Tuesday closure are UTC or local; the bracketed times appear to be the summer values; they are copied as written, not converted. The SEA noise action plan only mentions an engine-run ban 22:00-05:00 and a national night-flight decree (D.P.R. 476/99) without terms, so no curfew was recorded. Slot quote from ENAC page (updated 14/11/2024); the coordinator is Assoclearance ('l’associazione Assoclearance che è stata incaricata del coordinamento'). Whether GA needs a slot is not stated there. Re-researched 2026-10-29: 29 Oct 2026: SEA Airport Regulations Linate, Edition 5.0 (RS/LIN/5.0, December 2024; English text, Italian prevails): 'OPERABILITY H24'. Section 2.2.1: 'Arriving flights in positioning between 22:00 LT and 06:40 LT will only be authorised after confirmation by the Airport Managing Company' (stand/gate availability); it is written for airline positioning flights, so it was not recorded as a business-aviation curfew. The West Apron has '6 for narrow-body aircraft' stands '(maximum wingspan of 48 metres)', but the text does not say the West Apron is the GA apron, so max_aircraft was not recorded. The regulations' technical annexes (Ed. 5.0, 13 Dec 2024) and the Linate Airport Manual chapters read have no GA, customs, fuel or de-icing rules. The full English regulations text (132,811 characters) could only be read in part.
